hypothesis: One fixed context-8 representation+identifier recipe can operate across wave, Gray-Scott, and an NLS family absent from representation training, without a family label/router or family-specific dynamics parameters.

frozen_representation.training_mixture: 64 low-mode wave sequences + 64 smooth Gray-Scott sequences, seq_len 8, grid 16
frozen_representation.state_codec: 2048+128 residual VQ on joint physical state
frozen_representation.innovation_statistics: mean/std from raw one-step wave+Gray training-mixture differences only
frozen_representation.primary_codec: frozen Phase-10/11 asinh compander, 512 levels per channel, zmax 16, exactly 18 bits/cell/frame

frozen_identifier.features: constant; per-channel center, D4 axial radius-1 sum, diagonal radius-1 sum, axial radius-2 sum; plus center u^2, uv, v^2, u^3, u^2v, uv^2, v^3
frozen_identifier.feature_scaling: per-sequence RMS over all seven observed transitions; constant fixed to 1

evaluations.baseline: raw-state persistence from final raw context frame
evaluations.metric: companded projected rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE

execution_rule: Each registered replicate executes exactly once in an independent process and is persisted before the next. No retry, replacement seed, family-specific routing, context change, ridge change, feature change, tokenizer refit on NLS, compander change, or threshold change after a registered attempt is consumed.

pass_rule.required: PASS only if the same frozen context-8 companded arm has ratio < 1.0 versus raw persistence on all 11 splits in all 3 fresh replicates (33/33 cells).
pass_rule.failure_policy: Any registered ratio >= 1.0 makes Phase 14 FAIL. Remaining registered replicates should still run once for characterization if infrastructure permits.

pre_execution_validation: Phase-10 compander LEVELS=512 and ZMAX=16 unchanged
only non-registered smoke seeds before registered execution
claim_limit: A PASS would show one fixed discrete representation+context-identifier recipe beating persistence across three known synthetic PDE families under these tests, with the third family absent from representation training. It would not establish a universal scientific tokenizer, unrestricted law discovery, novel physics, AGI, or SSI.
